description: Implementation of the IpcModule class managing IPC channel attachment, detachment, and event subscription within the firebolt::rialto::client namespace.

classes.name: IpcModule
classes.description: Manages IPC channel lifecycle and event subscriptions for the Rialto client.

methods.name: IpcModule::IpcModule
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC client reference.

methods.name: IpcModule::unsubscribeFromAllEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all registered IPC events.

methods.name: IpcModule::attachChannel
methods.description: Attaches to an IPC channel, creating stubs and subscribing to events.

methods.name: IpcModule::detachChannel
methods.description: Detaches from the current IPC channel and unsubscribes from events.

methods.name: IpcModule::reattachChannelIfRequired
methods.description: Reattaches to a new IPC channel if the current one is disconnected.
